## Type of change

- [ ] feat - new user-facing behavior
- [ ] fix - bug fix (with a test that reproduces it)
- [ ] docs, refactor, test, ci, build or chore
- [ ] Breaking change (action removed or renamed, default binding changed, GLPI/PHP version dropped)

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type(scope): subject`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `make check` passes locally
- [ ] E2E specs updated when behavior changed (`make e2e`)
- [ ] Every new user-facing string exists in English and Spanish
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` updated when behavior changed
- [ ] Agent files updated (`.agents/MEMORY.md`, `.agents/KNOWLEDGE.md`, ADR if a decision changed)
